proposed_rssi_protocol.implementation_scope: Proposed four-message protocol over local TCP; this is not the raw 802.11 implementation or an official KEMTLS implementation.
proposed_rssi_protocol.kem: ML-KEM-768 with long-term identity key pairs for both endpoints; no forward secrecy.
proposed_rssi_protocol.identity_binding: SHA-256 fingerprints of raw liboqs public-key bytes pinned in-process before measurements.
proposed_rssi_protocol.rssi_input_source: Synthetic CLI values; loopback TCP provides no physical RSSI measurement.
